name: mem
description: Self-hosted, provider-agnostic memory layer: a system of record for what AI assistants know about you.

scripts.db:up: docker compose up -d db && docker compose exec -T db sh -c 'until pg_isready -U mem -d mem -q; do sleep 1; done; createdb -U mem mem_test 2>/dev/null || true'
scripts.eval:grader-sanity: PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 node --env-file-if-exists=.env --import tsx node_modules/promptfoo/dist/src/entrypoint.js eval -c eval/grader/sanity.yaml -o eval/results/grader-sanity.json --no-progress-bar; node --import tsx eval/grader/check-sanity.ts eval/results/grader-sanity.json
scripts.eval:run: PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 node --env-file-if-exists=.env --import tsx node_modules/promptfoo/dist/src/entrypoint.js eval -c eval/promptfooconfig.yaml -o eval/results/latest.json --no-progress-bar
